what: A 2.5rem ball that inverts what is beneath it follows the mouse, closing .2 of the remaining distance each frame, and stretches in the direction of travel by remaining distance/120 (max .38): width 1+c, height 1−.6c, rotated to that direction. Swing it fast and it elongates like a water drop. Over links and buttons it becomes a 4rem accent-colored ring, and over anything with data-cursor-label (channel switch, outbound links) it becomes a 5.25rem dark circle showing that label (size .5s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) · fill .4s · text .3s). The system cursor is left as is

options.reach: Remaining-distance denominator (px) at which the stretch is maximal, default 120
options.pick: CSS selectors where the state changes, default [data-cursor], a, button, label, select
options.--fx-sic-ball·--fx-sic-ring·--fx-sic-dis: Ball · ring · circle diameters (css variables), default 2.5rem · 4rem · 5.25rem

use: · data-cursor in place="channel" data-cursor-label="CHANNEL"
note: Spots with only data-cursor and no label (original play) leave the ball as is. Firing fx:cursor-reset on document clears the state (after a page transition)

from.where: index.html shared cursor (original brand-cursor — lerp .2 · stretch min(distance/120,.38) · backdrop invert · link ring 4rem · label circle 5.25rem)
